name: Beta-Love|Amore in Prova|
source:
Sometimes people prefer to live isolated from the dark and cruel society which surround them. That's what happened to Bali, a beta-tester, who's affected by misanthropy, depression, apathy and some others psychological disturbs. But, you know what? He doesn't really care! He's happy alone in his house, abandoned by a family that never believed in him, with his faithful digital butler Battista.

But one day Battista, worried for the inner health of Bali who hasn't put a foot out of his house since 2 months, tricks him to take a walk in the downtown. During his short stroll, he'll meet two guys that will change his life for the better...or not?

Oh, everything without mentioning the fact that television news are starting to talk about a mysterious young-men-raper in the city and about an as well mysterious and dangerous illness called Dementium which is driving people crazy and is causing death all around.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=29&t=15225]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
有时，人们更喜欢与周围黑暗而残酷的社会隔绝的生活。这就是巴里（Bali）身上发生的事情，她是一位Beta测试员，受到厌世、抑郁、冷漠和其他一些心理困扰的影响。但是，你知道吗？他根本不在乎！他独自一人在家里过得很开心，被一个从不相信他的家庭抛弃了，还有他忠实的数字管家巴蒂斯塔。

但有一天，巴蒂斯塔担心巴里的内心健康，巴里已经两个月没有踏出家门一步了，他骗他到市中心散步。在他短暂的漫步中，他会遇到两个人，他们会让他的生活变得更好……或者不会？

哦，一切都没有提及这一事实，电视新闻开始谈论城里一个神秘的年轻男子强奸犯，以及一种同样神秘而危险的疾病，称为痴呆症，它使人们疯狂并导致周围的人死亡。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=29&t=15225]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
